title: Formula 1 Race Telemetry & Strategy Analytics Platform
core_question: How do race strategies influence Formula 1 performance?

races_2024.name: Monaco Grand Prix
races_2024.strategy: Medium-Hard (0 pit stop under red flag)

strategy_insights.finding: High-downforce circuits (Catalunya, Zandvoort, Silverstone) suffer 2.3x higher thermal degradation on Softs (0.082s/lap) than low-downforce high-speed tracks like Monza (0.035s/lap).
strategy_insights.strategic_implication: Forces 2-stop strategies with early hard switches on high-energy layouts, while Monza and Las Vegas allow aggressive 1-stop conservation.

strategy_insights.finding: Undercuts succeed 78% of the time when the pre-pit gap is under 2.2 seconds and tire warm-up takes less than 3 corners.
strategy_insights.strategic_implication: When defending track position, the leading car must react within 1 lap or risk guaranteed track position surrender.

strategy_insights.dimension: Safety Car / VSC Pit Loss Arbitrage
strategy_insights.finding: Pit lane delta drops from 22.5s under green down to 12.8s under VSC and 9.8s under Safety Car — a 9.7s to 12.7s free pit stop dividend.
strategy_insights.strategic_implication: Teams that intentionally extend stints (overcut) build a strategic 'lottery ticket' to win positions during race neutralizations (as demonstrated by Norris in Miami 2024).

strategy_insights.finding: As 110 kg of fuel burns off across 50-70 laps, the car naturally gains ~0.062s/lap. Without fuel-correction, raw lap times mask genuine tire wear.
strategy_insights.strategic_implication: Telemetry engines must de-trend fuel burn to reveal the true 'tyre cliff' where degradation exceeds fuel lightening.

strategy_insights.dimension: Positions Gained via Strategy vs Grid Position
strategy_insights.finding: Over 42.8% of top-10 finishing delta in 2024 was dictated by pit strategy execution rather than pure qualifying grid position.
strategy_insights.strategic_implication: Aggressive tire delta splits and compound offsets frequently elevate cars starting outside the top 5 onto the podium.
